import pandas as pd
penguins = pd.read_csv('penguins.csv')
mean1 = penguins.bill_length_mm.mean()
mean2 = penguins.bill_depth_mm.mean()
mean3 = penguins.flipper_length_mm.mean()
mean4 = penguins.body_mass_g.mean()
penguins.bill_length_mm.fillna(mean1, inplace=True)
penguins.bill_depth_mm.fillna(mean2, inplace=True)
penguins.flipper_length_mm.fillna(mean3, inplace=True)
penguins.body_mass_g.fillna(mean4, inplace=True)
penguins.isnull().sum()

#penguins의 상자그림 그리기

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
penguins[['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].boxplot()

#penguins의 body_mass_g 이상치 확인하기

import numpy as np
q1, q3 = np.percentile(penguins['body_mass_g'],[25, 75])
iqr = q3 - q1
upper = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
lower = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
outliers = penguins['body_mass_g'][(penguins['body_mass_g'] > upper)|(penguins['body_mass_g'] < lower)]
outliers

#penguins의 body_mass_g 이상치 처리하기

penguins_outliers = penguins.drop(index = outliers.index)
print('이상치 제거 전:', penguins.shape)
print('이상치 제거 후:', penguins_outliers.shape)

a1, a3 = np.percentile(penguins['bill_length_mm'], [25, 75])
b = a3 - a1
penguins['bill_length_mm'][(penguins['bill_length_mm'] > a3 + 1.5 * b) | (penguins['bill_length_mm'] < a1 - 1.5 * b)]

c1, c3 = np.percentile(penguins['flipper_length_mm'], [25, 75])
d = c3 - c1
penguins['flipper_length_mm'][(penguins['flipper_length_mm'] > c3 + 1.5 * d) | (penguins['flipper_length_mm'] < c1 - 1.5 * d)]

e1, e3 = np.percentile(penguins['bill_depth_mm'], [25, 75])
f = e3 - e1
penguins['bill_depth_mm'][(penguins['bill_depth_mm'] > e3 + 1.5 * f) | (penguins['bill_depth_mm'] < e1 - 1.5 * f)]

import pandas as pd
penguins = pd.read_csv('penguins.csv')
mean1 = penguins.bill_length_mm.mean()
mean2 = penguins.bill_depth_mm.mean()
mean3 = penguins.flipper_length_mm.mean()
mean4 = penguins.body_mass_g.mean()
penguins.bill_length_mm.fillna(mean1, inplace=True)
penguins.bill_depth_mm.fillna(mean2, inplace=True)
penguins.flipper_length_mm.fillna(mean3, inplace=True)
penguins.body_mass_g.fillna(mean4, inplace=True)
import numpy as np
q1, q3 = np.percentile(penguins['body_mass_g'],[25, 75])
iqr = q3 - q1
upper = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
lower = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
outliers = penguins['body_mass_g'][(penguins['body_mass_g'] > upper)|(penguins['body_mass_g'] < lower)]
penguins_outliers = penguins.drop(index = outliers.index)
penguins_outliers.shape

from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
penguins_new = penguins_outliers[['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']]
normal = MinMaxScaler().fit_transform(penguins_new)
normal = pd.DataFrame(normal, columns = penguins_new.columns)
print(normal); print(penguins_new)
